mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrol.intro: First sign-in: scan this with your authenticator app, then enter a code to finish.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code — scan with your authenticator app
enrol.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter the code manually

recovery.intro: Save these one-time recovery codes somewhere safe — each works once if you lose your authenticator.
recovery.warning: They will not be shown again.

accept.title: Accept your staff invite
accept.intro: Set a password for your new staff account.
accept.alreadyAcceptedIntro: This invite was already accepted — the account's already set up. Sign in with its password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.intro: Changing your password signs you out everywhere, including this device — you'll need to sign in again with the new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your staff email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.doneIntro: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: This link is single-use and expires 1 hour after it was sent.
resetPassword.alreadyUsedIntro: This link was already used — your password's already been changed. Sign in with your new one.

invite.title: Invite staff
invite.intro: Send an invite to add a new Super Admin, Admin or Service Admin. The link is valid for 7 days.

manage.title: Staff
manage.intro: Everyone with access to the admin panel, and their role.

confirmUnlock.title: Unlock this account?
confirmUnlock.message: {email} will be able to sign in again.

confirmReactivate.title: Reactivate this account?
confirmReactivate.message: {email} will be able to sign in again.

confirmResetTotp.title: Reset authenticator?
confirmResetTotp.message: {email} will need to set up a new authenticator app the next time they sign in. Their existing recovery codes stop working too.

confirmDeprovision.title: Deprovision this account?
confirmDeprovision.message: {email} will be signed out everywhere and won't be able to sign in again until reactivated.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.validation: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.passwordResetTokenAlreadyUsed: This reset link was already used.
errors.mfaInvalid: That code isn't right. Try again.
errors.mfaAlreadyEnrolled: An authenticator is already set up for this account.
errors.accountLocked: This account isn't available. Contact another Super Admin.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.inviteEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.passwordBreached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.forbidden: Only a Super Admin can do that.
errors.cannotModifySelf: You can't do that to your own account.
